capabilities: Toggle <u> tags around the selection with Ctrl+U, removing them on a second press
Wrap each line of a multi-line selection separately so inline HTML stays valid
Wrap the word under the cursor when nothing is selected
Remove a surrounding or empty <u> pair instead of nesting tags
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory (submitted and under review); installable via BRAT or manually. Single 4.5 KB main.js, no settings tab or dependencies. Requires Obsidian 1.4.0+.
intentEvidence: It exists for the cases those ones get wrong, and which are still open issues in their trackers
motivation: The author found existing underline plugins buggy (toggle not removing tags, broken multi-line rendering, skipped words) and built this to fix those open issues.
problem: Markdown has no underline syntax and Obsidian gives bold and italic hotkeys but not underline, so underlining means typing raw HTML tags by hand.
summary: Editor command that toggles <u> underline tags around the selection or the word under the cursor, wrapping multi-line selections line by line.
